title: Die Glocke and spinning mercury
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Die Glocke and spinning mercury, about WWII at Germany / Poland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know the commab context where you had rotating spinning mercury according to this Polish journalist Igor Vitkowski

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that according to a Polish journalist named Igor Witkowski, a Nazi wartime project known as Die Glocke, German for "the Bell", involved rotating, spinning mercury. Michels places it in the context of Hans Kammler, a senior SS officer, during World War Two in Germany and Poland. If true, it would suggest the Nazis were experimenting with exotic propulsion or physics far beyond ordinary weapons.
